_comment: The running example is one real workflow in the learner's organisation that is done the slow way today. Capture it richly: a concrete recent instance, its inputs, its output, and where it is weak. Never store real personal data here.
_business_number_scale: Which of revenue, risk or cost this workflow touches, in the learner's words
_target_comment: Optional. One company or internal role the learner is aiming at. Blank is fine.
_comfort_level_scale: 1 = has never used an AI tool for work, 5 = uses AI tools daily and has directed one to build something; calibrates how deep the instructor goes
